create_structured_hex8_box.description: Create a structured HEX8 finite-element box using nodes and elements. This creates FE mesh entities, not CAD geometry solids.
notes: Verified in HyperMesh 2021 through the GUI listener on port 47883.
For display, enable element display and fit/zoom extents in HyperMesh.
Do not use *solidblock or *tetmesh for this route.

create_structured_quad4_shell_plate.description: Create a structured QUAD4 shell finite-element plate using nodes and elements in the XY plane. This creates FE shell mesh entities, not HyperMesh geometry surfaces.

source_evidence.evidence: Full FE plate creation: nodes=66, QUAD4 shell elements=50, SHELL_PLATE_CREATE_ERRORS=0

runtime_validation: Create four-node shell elements with *createlist nodes and *createelement 104 1 1 1.
Verify element_count increases after execution.
Verify the structured plate generated 66 nodes and 50 QUAD4 shell elements for a 200x100 plate with 20 mm element size in HyperMesh 2021.
notes: Verified in HyperMesh 2021 through the GUI listener on 2026-06-10.
This route creates FE shell elements directly; it does not create geometry surfaces and does not run surface automesh.
Shell property/material/thickness assignment remains blocked until datanames are execution-verified.

create_beam_line.description: Create a straight line with structured BAR2/BEAM finite elements using nodes and *createelement 60. This creates 1D FE beam elements plus a visual geometry line.
runtime_validation: Reject *createelement 2 because it produced typename=Plotel, not BEAM.
Create two-node BAR2/BEAM elements with *createlist nodes and *createelement 60 1 1 1.
Verify element_count increases and hm_getvalue reports typename=BEAM and config=60.
For the 500 mm / 10 division beam test, verify 11 nodes, 10 elements, and a visual geometry line.
notes: Verified in HyperMesh 2021 through the GUI listener on 2026-06-10.
This route creates FE beam elements directly; line meshing, orientation vectors, and exact LS-DYNA beam section datanames remain separate verification work.
Material/property component binding through materialid/propertyid had session evidence, but beam section width/height datanames remain blocked until verified.

create_discrete_element.description: Create a two-node HyperMesh DISCRETE spring element using *spring. This creates the FE connector element only; LS-DYNA SECTION_DISCRETE stiffness/damping datanames remain unverified.
runtime_validation: Create two nodes in the current component.
Execute *spring node_a node_b 1 "" 0.
Verify hm_latestentityid elements is non-zero.
Verify hm_getvalue reports typename=DISCRETE and config=21.
Do not set SECTION_DISCRETE stiffness/damping datanames until those fields are command-recorded and verified without catch.
notes: Verified in HyperMesh 2021 through the GUI listener on 2026-06-10.
This route creates the DISCRETE element only; property/card binding and LS-DYNA K export are outside the executable MCP route.

create_lumped_mass.description: Create a one-node HyperMesh MASS element using *masselement on a marked node. This creates the FE mass element only; property/card datanames remain unverified.
runtime_validation: Create one node in the current component.
Mark that node with *createmark nodes 1 node_id.
Execute *masselement 1 mass "" 0.
Verify hm_latestentityid elements is non-zero.
Verify hm_getvalue reports typename=MASS and config=1.
Do not set ELEMENT_MASS property/card datanames until those fields are command-recorded and verified without catch.
notes: Verified in HyperMesh 2021 through the GUI listener on 2026-06-10 with mass=10.
This route creates the MASS element only; material/property assignment remains blocked.

create_geometry_solid_box.description: Create an axis-aligned HyperMesh geometry solid box using *solidblock. This creates CAD/geometry solid entities, not FE elements.
runtime_validation: Capture SOLIDS_BEFORE from hm_entitylist solids id, with *createmark/hm_marklength fallback for older HyperMesh Tcl.
Execute *solidblock with axis vectors.
Capture SOLIDS_AFTER and SOLID_ID; hm_latestentityid is wrapped in catch.
Treat the route as failed unless solids_count increases.
notes: This route is source-verified from local Altair HM2025 scripts and still requires GUI runtime validation in the target HyperMesh 2024/older session.
Do not reuse this route for FE mesh creation.

create_geometry_surface_rect_nurbs.description: Create an axis-aligned rectangular HyperMesh geometry surface in the XY plane using *surfacecreatenurbs. This creates geometry surface entities, not shell FE elements.
runtime_validation: Capture SURFACES_BEFORE from hm_entitylist surfaces id, with *createmark/hm_marklength fallback for older HyperMesh Tcl.
Execute *createdoublearray with u/v knots and four rectangular control points.
Execute *surfacecreatenurbs 1 1 2 2 2 2 0 1 16.
Capture SURFACES_AFTER and SURFACE_ID; hm_latestentityid is wrapped in catch.
Treat the route as failed unless surfaces_count increases.
notes: Verified in HyperMesh 2021 through the GUI listener on 2026-06-10.
This route creates a geometry surface only; it does not create QUAD4 shell FE elements.
Surface meshing and LS-DYNA shell property/material assignment remain separate unsupported routes until recorded and verified.
